summary: Fixes false update prompts, installs all required S5 asset packs before the Creator Hub opens, and updates Studio in place from GitHub before restarting.
notes: Fixes false Update Available state by identifying the running Studio as 5.2.1.
All enabled asset packs are checked/installed before the Creator Hub opens.
Core 50 and Chain Templates Pack A are both required auto-install packs.
Pack cache uses Cache Storage first with IndexedDB fallback.
Update & Restart refreshes hosted Studio code and restarts without downloading another EXE.
Permanent launcher cache-busts app/latest.html on every launch.
